turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, nice to hear from you. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I want to sign my daughter up for a Saturday morning activity, and she can't decide either.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me finish describing every option before you respond.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A drama club at the community centre, lots of games and a little show at the end of term.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Junior tennis lessons at the park, small groups, but outdoors even when it's cold.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or a coding club at the library for kids her age, free, but some say it's quite quiet and serious.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything. Which one would you pick?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: It really depends on her. If she's outgoing and loves to perform, the drama club will be a blast. If she's more of a puzzler, the coding club is free and could spark something.
